comment: Model-authored intent titles for shell tool calls (stigmer#276). `argField` is the wire key the harnesses write the intent phrase into: the native harness's tool-intent middleware (backend/services/runner/src/middleware/tool-intent.ts INTENT_ARG) extends the shell tool's bind-time schema with it, and the Cursor harness's built-in Shell tool carries it natively. Clients render it as the row title when present, falling back to the category label. Extraction is SHELL-kind-scoped on purpose: `description` means other things on other tools (a task tool's description is the sub-agent subject, never a row title). Cases: `name`+`mcpServerSlug` classify the kind, `args` is the persisted ToolCall.args, `intent` is the expected extraction (null = fall back to the label).
